what.text: This page follows refugees from El Salvador living in Costa Rica, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1359 Salvadoran refugees in Costa Rica, 2.0% of all refugees from El Salvador.
The United States hosts the most Salvadoran refugees, followed by Mexico, Italy and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of El Salvador from 1979 to 1991, with the FMLN among the opponents.
The main years of displacement in the data, 1980 to 1992, overlap that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1980 at 7500 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 10370, at the end of 1982, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Costa Rica.
These are year-end totals for Costa Rica only, reported to UNHCR.
